title: Two-cell tape action
statement: For $n\in\mathbb{N}$, positions $j,j'\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and tape actions $a,a'$, define an action on an $n$-cell array by assigning $a$ at $j$ and then assigning $a'$ at $j'$, leaving all other cells idle. If $j=j'$, the assignment at $j'$ determines the resulting action at that position.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ and $j'$ are positions among the $n$ cells
